verdicts.reason: A is the original scaled down and pushed against the left edge, leaving about a third of the canvas as empty white on the right, so it is lopsided and clearly unfinished. B is the same unchanged shrink, centred with blank white bars on both sides. It is balanced but still letterboxed, with nothing rearranged for the wide format, and the small 'HOW TO LEVEL UP'/search-bar headline doesn't make use of the extra width.
